_comment: Demo overrides for the effect catalog. Adds a single new effect (`hellfire_aura`) to demonstrate inheritance + addition. Every effect defined in default/effects.json is inherited unchanged.

effects.name: Hellfire Aura
effects.description: Wreathes the bearer in faint infernal flame; nearby foes take a small amount of fire damage at the start of their turn.

effects.name: Detect Traps!
effects.description: Traps are revealed before the party steps on them.
